    • 字段详细资料

      • acc

        @NameInMap(value="Acc")
public String acc

        The custom hotline parameters in JSON format.

        example:

        {"time":1}

      • accountName

        @NameInMap(value="AccountName")
public String accountName

        The name of the agent account, which is the mobile phone number or email address provided during account registration. The name must be unique within the instance.

        example:

        username@example.com

      • act

        @NameInMap(value="Act")
public Integer act

        The operation type. Valid values:

        • 1: hotline.
        • 2: online.
        • 3: ticket.
        example:

        1

      • biz

        @NameInMap(value="Biz")
public String biz

        The custom business parameters in JSON format.

        example:

        {"name":123}

      • clientToken

        @NameInMap(value="ClientToken")
public String clientToken

        The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification and can be generated by using a UUID.

        example:

        46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d9****

      • fromSource

        @NameInMap(value="FromSource")
public String fromSource

        The source type. Valid values:

        • hotlinebs_out: hotline.
        • ticket_out: ticket.
        • other_system_out: other systems.
        example:

        hotlinebs_out

      • instanceId

        @NameInMap(value="InstanceId")
public String instanceId

        The ID of the AICCS instance. You can obtain the instance ID in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        ccc_xp_pre-cn-***
